title: New Austin Rehab for Homeless Women Approved
summary:
*   **Social Services Boost:** Austin's housing finance board authorized a new residential rehabilitation facility to support homeless women.
*   **Targeted Recovery:** This facility will specifically address drug and alcohol abuse among homeless women.
*   **Community Partnership:** The Austin Drug and Alcohol Abuse Program, Inc. will operate the facility at 4606 Connelly Street under a two-year lease with an option to purchase.
